name: Encore Open-Source Backend Framework
free_limit: MPL-2.0 open-source backend framework, compiler, SDK and CLI for Go/TypeScript local development and self-managed Docker deployment, without a software license fee.
watch_out: This entry covers the open-source framework, not free hosted compute. Self-hosted production deployments require user-managed cloud, databases, networking and operations; Encore's managed platform, Pro automation and underlying AWS/GCP resources can incur charges. MPL-2.0 file-level copyleft obligations apply.
